description: Central Asia Photovoltaic Power Plants（2010-2023） is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors qiuli yang. This dataset contains geographic and environmental feature information for photovoltaic (PV) power plants across Central Asia, covering projects from 2010 to 2023. It includes key indicators such as slope, aspect, latitude and longitude coordinates, land cover type, area, and year of construction. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 7231068 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
